guarantees.claim: When cfg_block is true, update_seckey_inprocess is the logical OR of all reg2hw.key[i].qe bits for i = 0..31; when cfg_block is false, update_seckey_inprocess is 0.

assumptions.claim: External logic ensures that at most one reg2hw.key[i].qe bit is active at a time, so that update_seckey_inprocess correctly indicates a single key update operation.
assumptions.risk: If multiple key QE bits are simultaneously active, update_seckey_inprocess remains asserted until all are cleared, potentially causing incorrect state transitions or key write conflicts.

uncertain_points.claim: The loop uses hardcoded 32; if the actual number of key entries is parameterized (e.g., NumKeys) and not equal to 32, some key QE bits may be missed or out-of-bounds access occurs.
uncertain_points.cond: when key array size differs from 32
uncertain_points.risk: Missing key update signals could prevent secure key processing or cause silent failure; out-of-bounds could lead to simulation/synthesis mismatches.

uncertain_points.claim: The design ORs all key QE bits together; it is unclear whether simultaneous multiple key updates are intended or forbidden.
uncertain_points.cond: if multiple reg2hw.key[i].qe bits are asserted
uncertain_points.risk: Ambiguous update signal semantics may lead to key corruption or race conditions if unhandled downstream.
